title: The Letter in the Number Tray
request: These two whole-number readings may arrive as numbers or text. Deliver a numeric array in first, second order, adding bonus to each.
objective: Convert numeric text before constructing a numeric array.
hints: Compute a numeric reading for first and second, then add bonus to each value in the resulting array.
Use int(first) and int(second) before make_array; + adds bonus element-wise to an array.
Write readings = make_array(int(first), ___), then deliver(readings + bonus).
inputCode:
import random
first = str(random.randint(1, 20)) if random.randint(0, 1) else random.randint(1, 20)
second = str(random.randint(1, 20)) if random.randint(0, 1) else random.randint(1, 20)
bonus = random.randint(1, 5)
